Blocked-by: #16453

Same step and script as flight V; dispatched when V merges. Skills lane seat, 2026-09-07T02:5xZ.

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**Scope gap recorded from #16496 / PR #16754 (contract review, patch round 1):** this card's hourly full run must explicitly include `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, not only `ci.yml` / Test Core.

Measured on `main` at `5e53d73d`:

- `lint.yml` has **no `schedule:` trigger** — its `on:` is `push` → `main`, `pull_request`, `merge_group`. #16496's card ruling 1 says "`push` on `main` and the hourly full run (#16467) keep the full battery", but no hourly run of `Lint & Type Check` exists today.
- The push-on-`main` run of `Lint & Type Check` is the only post-merge full-battery run of the families #16754 scopes on merge groups (PM dispatch-gates self-test, both ratchets, verify-lock self-test, comment-mask corpus), and it is `cancel-in-progress` — this card's own measurement has 36 of 60 push runs cancelled.
- **No workflow consumes a red push-`main` run of `Lint & Type Check`**: `merge-queue-triage.yml` listens to `workflows: [CI]` only. A scoped family that goes red on `main` after a group skipped it has no filer.

What #16754 does about it: the selector runs every family for any event other than `merge_group` / `pull_request`, so the moment `lint.yml` gains a `schedule:` trigger the full battery runs there with no further change. What this card owes, so #16496's acceptance item 3 ("a scoped family that goes red on the hourly full run files the same deduplicated card shape #16455's nightly uses") is reachable: the hourly `schedule` on `lint.yml` as well as `ci.yml`, and a red-run card filer that watches `Lint & Type Check` as well as `CI`.

⛔ Nothing on this card was changed by this note beyond the record; the ruling on how to fold `lint.yml` in stays with the PM.

Session: `session_012GKcPZbMoGq7WPzKLfRBTU`

Worktree: `objectstack-issue-16467`
Domain: `domain:devx`
Container & model: `M`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — `TIER_DEFAULT`. ⛔ Not the floor: this card **narrows what gets tested on `main`**, and two of its couplings are load-bearing and unstated on the card.
Clause-②: no
Reason for `no`: `.github/workflows/**` + `scripts/ci/**` only. No `packages/**` path, no published surface. Judged from content.
Thread-read: card body in full + both comments (`5564351155` blocked-by, `5578952497` the `lint.yml` scope gap).
Blocker cleared: **#16453 closed `completed` 2026-09-07T04:04:40Z** — verified by this seat, not taken from the card.
Serial constraints cleared: all **17** open PRs' changed-file lists fetched **paged to exhaustion** at 2026-09-08T23:2xZ, filtered for `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` and `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml` — **zero hits** on all four. Control: 17 of 17 returned a non-empty list.

**File surface** — declared wide enough for the couplings below, ⛔ not just for the card's title:
`.github/workflows/ci.yml` · `.github/workflows/lint.yml` · `scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` (+ its selftest) · `scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs` (+ its self-test) · `.github/workflows/shard-timings-refresh.yml` · the red-run filer (a new workflow, or an extension of an existing one — your call, argue it). Stop on breach and explain in the report.

**Authority**: maintainer-directed, quoted verbatim on the card — 「同意你的建议，你负责执行派发所有可行的优化」. ⛔ This card is **not** yours to re-argue on cost grounds. It **is** yours to refuse on a safety ground if you find one, loudly, with the measurement.

## ⛔ TWO HAZARDS THE CARD DOES NOT NAME. This seat found both; ⛔ neither is optional.

### HAZARD 1 — the hourly run will be **cancelled by the next merge**, silently

```
ci.yml:45-47    group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
                cancel-in-progress: true
lint.yml:71-73  group: lint-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ … || github.ref }}   (same shape)
```

On a `schedule` event `github.event.pull_request.number` is empty and `github.ref` is `refs/heads/main` — **byte-identical to a push to main**. ⇒ The hourly full run and every push run share one concurrency group with `cancel-in-progress: true`, so **the next merge kills the hourly run**, and the hourly run kills the push run.

⭐ This is fatal to the card's entire value: its promise is *one complete full run per hour*, and the card's own measurement is that **36 of the last 60 push runs were cancelled**. Ship it as-is and the hourly run joins that 60%. ⇒ **The scheduled run must have its own concurrency group** (put `github.event_name` in the key), and a scheduled run must **never** be cancel-in-progress against a push. Pin it: assert the two groups differ.

### HAZARD 2 — the shard-timings dataset would be regenerated from a **partial** measurement

`select-shard-packages.sh` states twice, at `:29-30` and `:219-220`, that the push run's full list *is the ground truth the shard-timings refresh reads*. That is not decoration — it is wired:

```
scripts/ci/select-shard-timings-run.mjs:265   `?event=push&branch=main&status=completed&per_page=${limit}`
```

⚠️ And the eligibility test is **six shard jobs concluded `success` + artifacts present** (`:107`, `:122`, `:139`). It does **not** check that the run measured the *whole* package set. ⇒ The moment push becomes affected-only, that selector starts feeding the balancing dataset from runs that measured a handful of packages, **and every guard it has still reads green**. A dataset silently regenerated from a partial run is precisely the rot `shard-timings-refresh.yml`'s own header calls «one-directional and silent».

⇒ **Repoint the selector at the hourly full run** (`event=schedule`), or give it a full-list attestation it must verify. ⛔ Do not leave `event=push` in place. And update **both** prose sites in `select-shard-packages.sh` — a comment that still calls push the ground truth after you changed push is a lie the next reader will trust.

## The ruling this card left to the PM — `lint.yml` IS folded in

Comment `5578952497` records the gap and hands the ruling here. **Ruling: yes, fold it in.** `lint.yml` has no `schedule:` today, its push-on-`main` run is the only post-merge full-battery run of the families #16754 scopes on merge groups, and it is `cancel-in-progress`. ⇒ the hourly `schedule:` goes on **both** files, and the filer watches **both** `CI` and `Lint & Type Check` — `merge-queue-triage.yml:142` is `workflows: [CI]` only today, which is why a red `Lint & Type Check` on `main` currently has **no filer at all**. Without this, #16496's acceptance item 3 is unreachable.

## The four ruling items, with anchors re-taken on `origin/main` `db4bf90384`

1. **push → affected against `github.event.before`.** The selection lives in `scripts/ci/select-shard-packages.sh` (230 lines; `EVENT_NAME` dispatch at `:75`, `pull_request` `:81`, `merge_group` `:128`, and push currently falls to the **full-list** else-branch at `:206+` by design). A zero sha (first push, force-push) falls back to the full list **loudly** — the file already has the idiom: `echo "::warning::…"` beside every fallback. Copy it, ⛔ do not invent a quiet one.
2. **`schedule: '0 * * * *'` + `workflow_dispatch`** on `ci.yml` and `lint.yml`; the selection script treats both as **full**. ⛔ Watch the existing `on:` comments — `ci.yml:1-40` carries #16482's rationale for the *absent* `pull_request` branch filter, and an explicit ⛔ against mirroring anything onto `push:`. Read it before you touch that block; your change is to `push:`'s *selection*, not to its trigger.
3. **A red scheduled run files one deduplicated card.** The idiom to copy is `.github/workflows/test-nightly-tiers.yml` (#16455) — fixed title prefix as the card's identity (`:117`), de-dup by scanning **open** issues for that prefix or an embedded marker (`:470-480`), `issues.create` only when none matched (`:505`). Body carries the run link and `git log` between the previous **green** scheduled run's sha and this one. ⛔ One card that gets refreshed, never a card per red run.
4. **The timings refresh** — hazard 2 above. Ruling item 4 says «say so in the workflow comment»; that is necessary and ⛔ nowhere near sufficient. The comment is the smallest part of this item.

## Landing discipline for this card specifically

⛔ **Do not land the push narrowing without both the hourly full run and the filer in the same PR.** Narrowing push while nothing else runs the full battery, and nothing files on red, leaves `main` less tested than today with no one watching — strictly worse than not doing this card. If you cannot complete the filer, **land nothing** and report why. ⚠️ Partial delivery here is a coverage regression, not progress.

## Acceptance

- The hourly run's concurrency group **differs** from a push run's — asserted, not asserted-by-reading.
- `select-shard-timings-run` picks a **schedule** run; drive its self-test with a schedule-shaped run and prove a push-shaped one is no longer selected. ⛔ Its own self-test battery has a declared floor — raise it to what you actually run.
- `select-shard-packages.sh` on a `push` event with a real `before` sha selects the **affected** set; with a **zero** sha selects the full list **and warns**. Both in its selftest.
- **Negative control, mandatory**: `pull_request` and `merge_group` selection is **byte-identical** to today. This PR must not move them; prove it rather than assert it.
- The filer: a red scheduled run opens exactly **one** card; a second red scheduled run **refreshes** it and opens no second card. ⛔ De-dup untested is de-dup absent.
- ⛔ Every count with a firing control and a nonsense control. A zero without a control beside it is not a reading.

⛔ **The card relation goes in the PR BODY only** (`Part of #16467`), and **no commit message carries any card trailer** — `scripts/check-partof-closing-keyword.mjs` RULE 2 forbids all five spellings including `Refs #N`, and nothing clears that red once a commit is pushed.
